name: quantum-lms
description: Quantum LMS - Fullstack monorepo with segregated frontend and backend

scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix infra run typecheck
scripts.lint: node backend/node_modules/oxlint/bin/oxlint backend/src backend/scripts backend/tests frontend/src infra/bin infra/lib infra/scripts
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix backend run test:ci
